title: How to Beat Kuldra (Solo) — Heart Phase, Escape & Loot | RuneScape: Dragonwilds
author: GamingFilmLLC
description:
Here's how to beat Kuldra, the five-headed Dragon Queen and final boss of RuneScape: Dragonwilds — solo, on my first playthrough.

This guide walks the whole fight: the crystal arena phases, the elemental Anima and Resonator loop, the moment she goes down and you crawl INSIDE her to destroy the heart, and the "GET OUT NOW!" escape before she collapses. Stick around for the loot at the end — Dragonslayer's Cape, a shield, and a wand.

I came into this fight after clearing Velgar, Imaru, the Black Knight Titan, and Fuzan, then pushing through the Dragon Gate and the Scorned Wilderness. If you're gearing up for your own attempt, this is the full run, start to finish.

Subscribe to GamingFilm for more boss guides and kills — the saga may be done, but we're just getting started.
